boundaries: Two-body closed-form relations only; perturbations, transfers, reentry and attitude dynamics are excluded.
Root forms must be recorded in honest squared/cubed algebra (period-squared, velocity-squared, radius-cubed quantities) with the power explicit in the meaning name, or deferred with sources.
Central mass and gravitational parameter are supplied inputs with stated body and epoch, never assumed.
Orbital elements beyond semi-major axis and period (eccentricity, inclination) are out of scope for this lane.
Expressions must be written in canonical base units of the runtime registry; never inline a conversion factor that belongs to unit scales (see the canonical-units rule).
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent source chapters/subtopics inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
integration_expectation: New meanings (period_squared, velocity_squared, orbit_radius_cubed, parallax_distance, synodic_period and similar) and units (AU, parsec, day, year-count and similar) require extension; all seed forms use integer powers only and fit the engine once meanings exist. Calendar durations stay dimensionless counts, never physical-time conversion.
mission: Curate atomic reusable algebraic orbital relationships: Kepler periods, circular-orbit energy forms, parallax distance and synodic periods, each with explicit central body and circular-orbit scope. Two-body algebra only; continue through successive batches with no inference chain required.
priorities: Period-squared from semi-major axis and central mass (Kepler third law, squared form)
Velocity-squared for a circular orbit from central mass and radius
Synodic period from two sidereal periods
special_checks: Name the power in every squared/cubed quantity meaning so no consumer mistakes period-squared for a period
Guard positive central mass, radius and periods; equal sidereal periods reject the synodic form (no resonance singularity)
Keep 4pi-squared and similar literals explicit with stated precision
Distinguish the two-body idealization from any perturbed or N-body claim
